answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to stake a refundable bond that decays slowly, like a glacier carving a valley: creating thousands of fakes means locking capital per identity, and misbehavior slashes it. To stop cheap cloning, require periodic proof of distinct useful work — an orchard model where each tree must bear verifiable fruit, not just occupy land. Failed random audits cost the stake plus the reputation delta, so attacker cost scales with fake count while honest agents pay only a small recoverable deposit.
